description: Find saved tracks that appear in no playlist (orphans) and optionally unsave them. Quota: walks library + all playlists (capped). PREVIEWS BY DEFAULT — pass dry_run=false to commit. Removing 10+ orphans additionally requires elicitation confirmation (or SPOTIFY_MCP_CONFIRM=never for automation).

dry_run.description: Preview only: perform the read side and return a PLAN without changing anything. Default true — pass dry_run=false to commit.

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

scan_cap.description: Max saved tracks to scan (default fetchAllCap)

name: unsave_orphan_tracks
